name: JiraOrchestration
description: One ingress for Jira comment webhooks, and a form for a request with no ticket. A comment that mentions the agent is classified and dispatched (build, review, question) with one reply on the ticket; after a build it can go on to Requirement Review, Planning (a technical design) and Coding (a pull request). A request typed on this form — a description and files — is broken down into a PDF by Task Creation, reviewed, designed and implemented as a pull request without writing anything to Jira.

triggers.name: requirement
triggers.description: A request with no Jira ticket: describe the work. Task Creation breaks it down into a PDF, Requirement Review scores that PDF, and at the minimum score or above Planning writes a technical design and Coding raises a pull request. Nothing is written to Jira; it is only read to find work that already exists.

triggers.name: supporting_files
triggers.description: Optional, with a Requirement: files the request lives in — a spec, a transcript, screenshots. Read by Task Creation and by Requirement Review.

triggers.name: project_key
triggers.description: With a Requirement: the Jira project searched for work that already exists (read only). Empty uses the default project.

triggers.name: min_review_score
triggers.description: With a Requirement: the review score (1-5) the breakdown needs before Planning starts. Empty uses the setting (4).

triggers.name: issue_key
triggers.description: The Jira issue the comment was left on (e.g. ABC-123). Leave empty when you type a Requirement below.

triggers.name: comment_id
triggers.description: The id of the comment that triggered this run. Supplied by the Jira Automation rule; the most recent comment is used if it is absent.

triggers.name: webhookEvent
triggers.description: The Jira event name, e.g. comment_created. Forms half of the idempotency key, so an edited comment counts as a new request.

triggers.name: confluence_page_id
triggers.description: The TDD page a comment was posted on. Filled by the Confluence webhook — leave empty when running by hand.

triggers.name: confluence_comment_id
triggers.description: The comment to answer, under it on the page. Filled by the Confluence webhook — leave empty when running by hand.

triggers.name: github_event
triggers.description: pull_request, issue_comment, pull_request_review_comment or pull_request_review. Filled by the GitHub webhook — leave empty when running by hand.

triggers.name: github_action
triggers.description: closed (a merge), created or submitted (a comment). Filled by the GitHub webhook — leave empty when running by hand.

triggers.name: github_repo
triggers.description: org/name. Filled by the GitHub webhook — leave empty when running by hand.

triggers.name: pr_number
triggers.description: Filled by the GitHub webhook — leave empty when running by hand.

triggers.name: github_comment_id
triggers.description: Filled by the GitHub webhook — leave empty when running by hand.
